inference: Full pinned Tev1 0.8B released checkpoint, BF16, eager attention, native publisher system and JSON payload, thinking disabled, single-case forward, full final-position vocabulary logits. T=1 softmax over every supplied option letter. No truncation or prompt selection.
smoke: Repeat all four frozen native probes before any public case. Require identical predictions and max probability delta <= 0.00001.
evaluation: All 6151 original public decisions in 21 tasks, plus all 1100 reversed-option MASSIVE cases. Raw accuracy, ECE15, NLL, Brier, typed soft accuracy, official SemIf family metrics and option-order flip. Option-index macro-F1 is diagnostic only; semantic macro-F1 can be recomputed for app and intent taxonomies.
scope: Exploratory utility comparison against already-observed public suites and frozen Qwen/Decider outputs; training exposures differ. No calibration fitting, training, threshold selection, quality-driven tuning or runtime promotion. Published hosted-model parity and development scores are not measured here.
compute: Local shared run_heavy lock, four threads, original thermal governor/watchdog, 45-minute worker cap including loading. No paid endpoint or new cloud resource.
failure_policy: Stop and retain partial raw rows on source/model mismatch, smoke failure, context bound, memory, thermal or deadline error. No silently dropped cases or precision changes.
